title: Startup Cell & Incubation | KPGU
content: ation National Entrepreneurship Network, to accelerate entrepreneurship, innovation and skills development among students. Centre for Entrepreneurship Technology Incubation and Business Acceleration Krishna School of Emerging Technologies & Applied Research has established Centre for Entrepreneurship, Technology Incubation and Business Acceleration (CETIBA), an incubation centre to enable start-ups with an efficient mentoring program, relevant training and a convenient co-working hub.
